parameters.name: AcceleratorId
parameters.description: The ID of the Global Accelerator instance.

parameters.name: AccessMode
parameters.description:
The access mode of the acceleration area. Valid values:

- anycast: queries the supported anycast acceleration areas.

- Other values: queries the supported non-anycast acceleration areas.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the Global Accelerator instance is deployed. Set the value to **cn-hangzhou**.
